Short, reconstructed fictional scenario inspired by the repository's Dream of the Red Chamber ending demo. This is not the original 80-chapter corpus and does not reproduce that demo's predictions.
Jia Baoyu is attached to Lin Daiyu and enjoys poetry. Lin Daiyu is sensitive and values Baoyu's affection. Xue Baochai is practical and attentive to family expectations. Grandmother Jia cares about Baoyu and wants stability for the household. Wang Xifeng manages household affairs under financial pressure. The Jia household faces a fictional decision: reduce lavish celebrations and devote its remaining funds to preserving the garden. Baoyu asks Daiyu and Baochai to discuss this proposal. Grandmother Jia asks Wang Xifeng to explain its cost. No ending has yet been decided.
